verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for self-hostable relay software, but the evidence pack never documents whether MoQ Relay collects usage data or how to disable it. The 'telemetry' mention in docs-17 refers to user application data carried over relays, not product tracking. Self-hosting a private CDN is an adjacent deployment choice, not a documented opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
